title: A uniform multiplication proof for the 480-factor mixed-rank bound
body:
This submits a constructive proof for the complete 480-factor mixed-rank multiplier. For every pair of n-bit binary integers, the specified deterministic fixed multitape machine returns their exact product in O(n(log n)^(1−κ)) time and O(n) maximum visited tape space, with **κ = 0.00387992803556**. The exponent is the one already priced in [PR #7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830). The result submitted here is the removal of the five research premises for that price. The complete proof includes written mathematics and partial Lean verification. [Theorem and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/README.md) · [Obligation ledger](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/OBLIGATIONS.md) · [Original conditional receipt](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/RESULT.json)

The binary word has 36 native calls and the complex word has 48. The ordinary supplier reaches 0.003879928035646. The separately accounted CRT conversions still give saving 0.003879928035626 before logarithmic factors. All grouped Hadamards operate on the complete dyadic field. A discarded face and its retained core use the same normalization. The final decoder carries both source-length factors and both input digit scales. [Formal physical-coordinate decoder](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/lean/PublicGrid.lean) · [Kernel-checked cost inequalities](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/lean/OuterPrices.lean)

We built the Lean modules and replayed their compiled declarations through the kernel. Their printed axiom sets are subsets of `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. The finite compiler's real majorant, the transcendental Gaussian estimates and the tape running-time proof include written steps. The short-word multiplier of Harvey and van der Hoeven and Trudgian's explicit prime estimate are independent published theorems. The submitted all-size result awaits independent scientific review. It gives no practical cutoff. [Formal boundaries and replay instructions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/VERIFICATION.md) · [Evidence](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/EVIDENCE.json)

With CPython 3.12, from the repository root, run

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition
```

The small integration test and package runner finish with

```text
741503 x 466013 = 345550037539 coefficients [11811, 10996, 4152, 868, 77]
PASS_JOINED_SMALL_GEOMETRY
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition outcome=completed
```

The full pinned source replay authenticates 148 bindings and reproduces the original application and independent audit bytes. The small product uses a 5×7 source and 8×8 target. The integer interval generator produced every diagnostic Gaussian page. Checks also cover all rows of two fine-prime maps. The all-size supplier proof uses the pinned finite words. A complete execution at the astronomical first carrier remains untested. [Source replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/replay_sources.py) · [Product probe](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/check_product.py)

The repository navigation test `CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` failed on the unchanged canonical files. The selected receipt requires `make frontier7000-verify`, while the CI guide names the earlier selected family. The six package checks and the separate Lean build passed. [Navigation test](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/tests/test_research_current_status.py) · [CI guide at the base](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/ci-verification.md)

The base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, the mixed price is pinned at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15` and the raw all-column predecessor at `a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e`. @Clear1nsight supplied the mixed rule and its application. The native transfer uses the exact source work in [PR #7837](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7837). The grade-14 precursor is [PR #7835](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7835), submitted by @rohanarun. Its [source credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/43007c979859fa84ccc3a3509ccacc9620d181fa/research/p104-grade14-paid-cut/README.md) identifies the contributor. Cinna Davis supplied the earlier balanced CRT and outer proof. The Gaussian, compiler and ordinary-bridge predecessors retain their source credit. @aliromman prepared the integration with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
